summary: Pin sits in steep dense bush behind houses, with no track or vehicle access.
reasons: No track or tyre marks reach it

drivers.seclusion: Bush to the east is secluded, but the pin is on a wooded hillside with homes within 40 to 80 m to the west and south.
drivers.access_and_room: No formed track, clearing or vehicle visible within 100 m; the cleared ground to the north-west looks like private yards.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential streets nearby; none at the pin.
drivers.convention: No sign of vans, tents or parking here.

flags: Steep: up to about 29% grade, 11% mean
Cleared area north-west appears to be private property
sun_shade: Under dense tree canopy, shaded from all sides.
cannot_judge: Whether a walking track runs through the bush
